text:
Nora (Head of Finance): :wave: FYI — were running a month-end discretionary budget sweep for all teams. Goal: recover uncommitted discretionary dollars and reallocate to high-priority launches and runway protection. Sweep window: 2026-03-25 to 2026-03-31.

Nora (Head of Finance): What you need to do: 1) review your team's discretionary spend lines in the Budget Portal (link below), 2) mark any non-essential subscriptions or pilots as "defer" or "cancel" by 2026-03-28, 3) submit reallocation requests for strategic needs using the Reallocation Form.

Nora (Head of Finance): Links: Budget Portal: https://redwood.internal/budget-portal; Reallocation Form: https://redwood.internal/forms/reallocation. Well publish a summary of recovered dollars and priority reallocations the week of 2026-04-01. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Peter (FP&A): Quick clarification  this sweep targets discretionary (non-payroll, non-contractual) lines only. Committed contracts, already-signed Dedicated capacity, and headcount are excluded. If something is labeled discretionary but is actually contractual, tag it in the form and we'll exclude it.

Rina (Procurement): New process note: to speed customer-impacting launches during the sweep window, Procurement is opening a temporary FastTrack queue. Eligible requests: vendor onboarding or one-off purchases required to meet a public launch or critical SLA. FastTrack rules: 1) submit the FastTrack form (link below) with a short justification and launch date, 2) include the product/incident owner, 3) limit: 3 FastTrack approvals per team during the sweep.

Rina (Procurement): FastTrack form: https://redwood.internal/forms/fasttrack-procurement. Approvals require Procurement + FP&A signoff but well aim for <=12h turnaround for properly documented requests marked "LAUNCH" or "SLA". Tag @Rina and cc procurement@redwood.com for expedite.

Jason (Eng PM): Question  does FastTrack apply to marketplace purchases (e.g., cloud marketplace third-party subscriptions)?

Rina (Procurement): Good Q. If the vendor is procured via an existing marketplace contract with monthly billing, submit a FastTrack with the marketplace reference and attach screenshots of the pricing page. Marketplace purchases are eligible but we may require the marketplace PO number for AP.

Peter (FP&A): Also adding: any approved reallocation that increases monthly recurring spend must include a counterbalancing savings line or a runway justification. Were trying to keep net run-rate neutral unless execs approve incremental spend.

Budget Bot: Automated reminder  teams with >$8k/month discretionary spend will get an automated checklist notification in the Budget Portal on 2026-03-26. Please complete by 2026-03-28 to avoid auto-flagging.

Jason (Eng PM): Noted. We have two noncritical monitoring pilots that can be paused. Will submit reallocation form for launch infra.

Nora (Head of Finance): One more thing  Procurement has updated the Vendor Eligibility Checklist: new requirement to include vendor tax residence and primary legal name in onboarding packet to speed AP setup. Template on Confluence. Link: https://redwood.internal/confluence/vendor-onboarding-checklist.

Rina (Procurement): If you need help filling the paperwork, Procurement office hours are today 14:00-15:00 PT. Drop into the procurement-help channel or book time with me.

Nora (Head of Finance): Thanks everyone  appreciate quick attention during the sweep. If you hit friction with FastTrack or the reallocation form, ping me or Peter directly. :pray:
